stories.headline: Ancep raises $8.5m in a round led by Creandum
stories.quote: London-based insurtech Ancep raised $8.5m in a funding round. Creandum led the round, with participation from Kleiner Perkins, Vicus Ventures and additional angels.

stories.headline: Seva Money raises $5m seed led by Blockwall and Revent
stories.quote: London-based remittance startup Seva Money raised $5m in a seed round of funding. Blockwall and Revent led the round, with participation from Seedcamp, Stride.VC, Ada Ventures and additional angels.

stories.headline: Numina raises €1.1m pre-seed
stories.quote: Copenhagen-based AI accounting startup Numina raised €1.1m in a pre-seed round of funding. Founders A/S, Emblem, Nebular, The Nordic Web and additional angels participated in the round.

stories.headline: Starling CEO Raman Bhatia to step down at the end of the year
stories.quote: Starling CEO Raman Bhatia will step down from his role at the end of the year.

facts.text: Bhatia succeeded founder Anne Boden and is leaving after two years.
facts.quote: Starling’s Raman Bhatia, who succeeded founder Anne Boden, is stepping down after two years.

stories.headline: Starling founder Anne Boden is building a digital bank for AI agents to move money for customers
stories.quote: Starling founder Anne Boden is building a digital bank aimed at allowing AI agents to move money for customers.

stories.headline: Revolut's $115bn valuation referred to as recent news
stories.quote: One big topic of the day was the news of Revolut’s $115bn valuation .

facts.text: Revolut valued at $115bn; the issue does not say what transaction set the valuation.

stories.headline: Sifted data: early-stage AI-native fintech back-office rounds rose from 62 to 87 between 2025 and 2026 so far
stories.quote: Sifted data shows the number of AI-native pre-seed, seed and Series A funding rounds in the segment rose from 62 to 87 between 2025 and 2026 so far, as startups launched since 2024 now make up 42% of the field.

facts.text: Funding rounds by early-stage AI-native fintech startups are up 40%.
facts.quote: Funding rounds raised by early stage AI-native fintech startups are up 40%, as European companies pile into the financial services back office hoping to become category leaders.
